caption: The drawing features a single ankle-high boot displayed in a side view, predominantly colored dark brown with a light brown outline along the upper edge and greenish accents near the eyelets and toe area. The boot has six eyelets arranged in two rows, with visible stitching along the seams. The outsole and heel are black, and the heel is low and solid. Above and to the left of the main boot, there are two smaller line drawings: one showing the top view and the other the bottom view of the same shoe, both in simple black outline without color. The drawing is positioned on a beige background with faint shading and has the name "Mae Szilvasy" written in the lower right corner.
title: Child's Shoe
